family_title_en: Spell the long a word: silent e, ai, ay

stages.ix_title: Spell the long a word: silent e, ai, ay
stages.choice_rule: Four unique whole-word spellings. Exactly one is the correct spelling of the long a word clued by the stem. The stem must not contain that correct spelling. Stems use only the roots word list, allowed extra words, and <NAME>. Tier 1 wrong choices drop a letter or scramble letters. Tier 2 wrong choices try a different long a pattern. Tier 3 wrong choices are near misses that use silent e, a and i, or a and y for the same word. Set explain_key to silent_e, ai_spell, or ay_spell to match the correct pattern. Add media with the target lemma.

gold_items.stem: A sweet treat on your birthday.
A long animal that can bite.
A stick of color for art class.
Red and yellow and blue in the sky.
<NAME> will eat a small green fruit.
<NAME> can run and jump by the swing.

roots: Each item has exactly four spellings, and exactly one of them is correct.
Wrong choices misspell the same target word. Do not offer a different real word.
Tier 1 misses drop a letter or scramble letter order so the error is easy to see.
Tier 2 misses try another long a pattern or add one extra letter.
Tier 3 misses are near misses that try silent e, a plus i, or a plus y on that same word.
Stay in the kid world of school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather. No brand names and no real child names.

tier_rules.1: Short clues of three to six words about food, play, or weather. The correct word is a common one-syllable long a word. The clue must not show the correct spelling. Wrong choices miss a letter or scramble letters.
tier_rules.2: Clues of five to eight words, including two-syllable words such as crayon or rainbow. Wrong choices try a different long a pattern or add one extra letter. The clue must not show the correct spelling.
tier_rules.3: Clues of seven to ten words, often with <NAME>. Every wrong choice is a near miss that tries silent e, a and i, or a and y for the same word. The clue must not show the correct spelling.

silent_e.en: A silent e at the end makes the a say its name.
silent_e.ko: 끝의 묵음 e 때문에 a는 자기 이름을 말합니다.

ai_spell.en: The letters a and i together spell this long a.
ai_spell.ko: 글자 a와 i가 함께 이 긴 a를 나타냅니다.

ay_spell.en: The letters a and y together spell this long a.
ay_spell.ko: 글자 a와 y가 함께 이 긴 a를 나타냅니다.
